item.title: The BeverlyBot Show Episode 3 – Joseph At The Ambulance
item.description: BeverlyBot is an automated telephone machine that curses at you whenever you call her. She consists of a few dozen sound clips that play in sequence whenever you call into the system at 270-558-1710. She will wait for you to finish screaming at her before she starts talking crazy again. She’s based on the Double Wide Beverly prank calls that I put up on YouTube a few years ago.
